_comment: Curate what the public site shows. 'hidden' repos are dropped entirely (use for client/confidential private repos). 'featured' float to the top with a highlight. 'overrides' let you replace the GitHub description or add a tagline/emoji per repo.

culinary-card.tagline: AI recipe manager that turns URLs, photos, or scribbles into beautiful cards — Stripe billing, Supabase auth, DALL·E food photography.

austin-auto.tagline: Auto-shop management tool with Anthropic AI, Supabase, and PDF invoicing.

asl-guide.tagline: Interactive American Sign Language tutor powered by AWS Bedrock and Framer Motion.

g2-offline-captions.tagline: Offline-first live captions for Even Realities G2 glasses — quantized ONNX (INT4) running locally on iOS.

christmas-nativity-game.tagline: A full 3D educational game — explore the nativity story from multiple perspectives in Three.js.

apartment-search.tagline: Multi-agent rental finder (Preference / Market / Listing analysts) with live Browserbase discovery and explainable scoring.

simple-strands.tagline: Multi-agent travel planner using a fan-out/fan-in architecture to research logistics and experiences.

tim-keller.tagline: RAG chatbot over 1,600+ sermons — local Voxtral transcription, pgvector, AWS Bedrock retrieval.
